title: Party, traits, nerve and health
summary: Roles, traits, nerve, disputes and injury.
bodyHtml:
Each member has health, nerve, trust in you, bonds with each other, one role and two traits.

Roles

Scout, mechanic, medic, hunter, guard, speaker. Roles unlock or improve options: a mechanic halves repair time, a medic stretches physic, a speaker bargains and talks people down.

Traits

Hothead, kind, paranoid, greedy, stoic, pious, coward, veteran, charming, sickly, haunted. Traits change how nerve is lost, how fights and quarrels go, who reads strangers well, and who breaks first.

Nerve

The party's mood and perception. Below 30 people are frayed and quarrels spike; at 0 someone may walk into the Haze. Frayed observers can misread tells, seeing evidence that points the wrong way.

Disputes

Quarrels are scenes: back one side, mediate (costs hours), cut it off, or look away and risk a fistfight. Some accusations carry hidden truth and tells too (who really took the rations).

Injury

Zero health does not kill outright. The member is dying and you have until the second nightfall to spend physic. Another hit while dying is fatal; rest does not help. Wounds bleed a little each night and may close on their own.

The wagon-master

A person in the party. If they die, the run ends. Sacrifice and crisis scenes never target them.

Roster

A 12-person roster plus recruitable strangers and nine named companions. See Content catalog and Companions.
